title: Exercise every fresh-nonce federation handoff retry and supersession boundary
outcome: Extend direct coverage of fresh write-ahead nonce creation and federation handoff latch ownership beyond the closed-channel outcome path, preserving exact same-attempt deduplication and stale callback rejection.
acceptance: Production-path tests cover begin_prompt_delivery_write_ahead_locked and other fresh nonce transitions, showing the old attempt's handoff latch cannot suppress the current attempt.
Tests show unchanged same-attempt replay is deduplicated and delayed callbacks cannot authorize another prompt, turn, runtime or write-ahead nonce.
